about: Chains of scripts run in ONE Python by checker-shape-check.mts (lib/checker-shape/sameProcess.mts). A step is fixed at its print size (size), fixed with a need given outright (need), or left unfixed (fixed: false).

scenarios.name: rc_context_after_fig_then_later
scenarios.origin: round 6, the page reviewer and skeptic-page-2 (s10 then s16)
scenarios.why: a context opened after a figure lowers title and label sizes; the next script's need omits titles

scenarios.name: style_context_paper_after_fig_then_later
scenarios.origin: round 6, the page reviewer and skeptic-page-2 (s11 then s16)
scenarios.why: style.context('seaborn-v0_8-paper') after a figure lowers every listed size; the next script's need omits titles, ticks and legends

scenarios.name: rc_context_decorator_after_fig_then_later
scenarios.why: an rc_context decorator lowers title and label sizes for a function called after a figure

scenarios.name: rc_context_then_plain_then_later
scenarios.why: a triple: an unfixed plain script after a fixed one, then a fixed one

scenarios.name: style_context_then_plain_then_later
scenarios.why: the same triple with a style context

scenarios.name: global_small_after_fig_then_later
scenarios.why: a script that sets listed rc keys globally, small, after a figure: it must keep its own values after its end

scenarios.name: rc_equal_need_then_later
scenarios.origin: round 6, the code reviewer (a07, need 17 given outright, then s16)
scenarios.why: a script that sets a listed key to exactly the need after a figure: its own value must stay after its end

scenarios.name: falling_need
scenarios.origin: harness v6 (round 5, R5-06: a smaller need after a bigger one)
scenarios.why: need 25, then 17, labels left to rcParams: the second script prints at its own 17

scenarios.name: rc_context_before_any_fig_then_later
scenarios.origin: round 6, skeptic-page-2 (v3 then s16): a negative control
scenarios.why: the context opens before any figure, so nothing of it outlives the script
